DLC2316:4:t_006:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「I am most deeply indebted to you!」

DLC2316:4:t_006:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You can chase your kill score all you like, but you're being far too reckless.」

DLC2316:4:t_006:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ソワサンシス$$ can't fight in that condition. Return to base.」

DLC2316:4:t_006:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yes, yes. Can't argue with the star student, meow.」

DLC2316:4:t_006:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The $$木星急行$$'s advance force is still out there. Hurry up.」

DLC2316:4:t_006:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「...I'm going to get the highest score, no matter what... Then I'll wreck that oath ceremony...」

DLC2316:4:t_007:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Will $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ be ready in time?」

DLC2316:4:t_007:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The outfitting is complete. Now it's a question of whether it awakens.」

DLC2316:4:t_008:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The main force, all right. There are far more of them than before.」

DLC2316:4:t_008:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We can't count on the $$宇宙軍$$ anyway. We have to do this!」

DLC2316:4:t_008:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's our Princess. I'll be counting on you.」

DLC2316:4:t_008:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's go! If we let them through here, we'll disgrace the $$トップレス$$ name!」

DLC2316:4:t_009:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This is bad, $$ニコラ$$! Another detachment is coming!」

DLC2316:4:t_011:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ニコラ$$! Use the Buster X Attack!」

DLC2316:4:t_011:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There are too many! We can't handle them all!」

DLC2316:4:t_012:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$キャトフヴァンディス$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_012:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$ソワサンシス$$... I was... selfish...」

DLC2316:4:t_012:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「Please, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$! Lend me your strength!」

DLC2316:4:t_013:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'll protect them...! We can do it, can't we, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$?!」

DLC2316:4:t_013:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$フィジカルキャンセラー$$, full power! $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_014:1.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Here it comes! A freezing beam with a theoretical temperature of minus 1,000,020,000,000 degrees!」

DLC2316:4:t_014:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That amount of thermal energy can't physically exist! What's going to happen?!」

DLC2316:4:t_014:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「He's gone now... He can't forgive me... for lying... But...」

DLC2316:4:t_014:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「This isn't for him... It's for me...!」

DLC2316:4:t_015:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Time is... flowing toward the past...」

DLC2316:4:t_017:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You did it, $$チコ$$, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_017:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry! $$チコ$$ took the $$バスターマシン$$, so I decided to pilot this combat machine instead!」

DLC2316:4:t_017:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You can do this, right, $$チコ$$?」

DLC2316:4:t_017:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「All right! We'll go straight on the offensive from here!」

DLC2316:4:t_017:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight, too! With hard work and guts!」

DLC2316:4:t_017:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Let's go, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$! For me... and for everyone!」

DLC2316:4:t_018:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For a while, I wasn't sure what would happen, but we pulled through.」

DLC2316:4:t_018:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This time, we owe it to $$チコ$$ and $$キャトフヴァンディス$$.」

DLC2316:4:t_019:0.en:
$$チコ$$
（Thank you, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$... I'll be counting on you from now on, too.）

DLC2316:4:t_019:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「...I caused you trouble, too, new girl.」

DLC2316:4:t_019:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's not exactly an apology, but I'll tell you something. These... weren't earrings.」

DLC2316:4:t_019:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Back then, I... crossed through time and saw him again...」

DLC2316:4:t_019:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Two circles and a crescent... A snowman's eyes and mouth...」

DLC2316:4:t_019:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「He was... dreaming about our promise... about the day we'd build a snowman together...」

DLC2316:4:t_019:11.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The $$木星急行$$ fragments frozen by the Buster Smash and then shattered are being pulled in by the moon's gravity...」

DLC2316:4:t_019:13.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yeah... It's just like snow falling on the moon...」

DLC2316:4:t_019:15.en:
$$チコ$$
（Goodbye, my first love... I'm going to... believe in the power of the $$トップレス$$...）

DLC2316:4:t_020:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! I did it! $$ノノ$$ is one step closer to $$ノノリリ$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_020:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
（$$キャトフヴァンディス$$ became $$チコ$$'s, but now I'm even more interested in her...）

DLC2316:4:t_100:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If $$チコ$$ only cares about her own score, it makes no difference whether she's here or not!」

DLC2316:4:t_100:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You and I will stop the $$木星急行$$, $$ニコラ$$!」

DLC2316:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we lose, the $$トップレス$$' existence becomes meaningless...!」

DLC2316:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's go, $$ヴァンセット$$! We have to keep winning!」

DLC2316:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「To think that $$チコ$$ would do that...」

DLC2316:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But I've got my pride, too! I'm not handing over the ace's seat that easily!」

DLC2316:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
（Was $$ノノ$$'s influence what made $$チコ$$ awaken $$キャトフヴァンディス$$, too...?）

DLC2316:4:t_104:0.en:
$$チコ$$
（Thank you, $$キャトフヴァンディス$$... For letting me see him as he was that day, even if only for a moment...）

DLC2316:4:t_104:1.en:
$$チコ$$
（But I won't look back anymore. I'll keep those memories in my heart.）

DLC2316:4:t_104:2.en:
$$チコ$$
（I...! I'll fight for what lies ahead!）

DLC2316:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It pains me to admit it, but $$チコ$$ and $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ suit each other perfectly.」

review.context: Tycho awakens Quatre-Vingt-Dix, sees the past through its impossible cold and remembers the snowman promise. Nono helps finish the battle as shattered enemies make lunar snow.
decisions: The source's written magnitude is minus one trillion twenty million degrees, retained literally rather than silently converting it to 1.2 trillion.
Nicola's growing interest in her refers to Nono, as shown by his immediately preceding remark and later Nono monologue.
Tycho's earrings are revealed to be the eyes and mouth of a promised snowman.
uncertainties: DLC2316 temperature lines literally say 1 trillion plus 20 million; kept the written magnitude despite its unusual form.
